}}'''Jurad Accan''' is an armsman under [[Luan Norwelyn]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jurad Accan}}

== Activities ==
He leads a party of men that are attacked by [[Arymilla Marne]]'s army just outside the [[Far Madding Gate]] in [[Caemlyn]]. He and his men are rescued by a sortie led by [[Daved Hanlon]].
